title: Ruleset
description: PROVISIONAL: the output of loadRuleset, passed to every other call. Packs merged in load order, inheritance and overrides resolved, content-only queries resolved. Plain data so it can be cached or sent between machines. Its internal shape beyond these top-level properties is engine-defined: a ruleset is only portable between instances of the same engine.

notices.description: The pack's other license notices, by name, in the order written.

fields.description: The fields, by qualified ID. PROVISIONAL shape, except that a field with `members` carries `tagOptions`: every tag the ruleset declares (with the tags above each) that it takes, sorted, for an app's picker. Content types' item fields and actions' parameters with `members` carry it too.

contentTypes.description: The content types, by qualified ID. PROVISIONAL shape, except that a type with a copy limit carries it as written (`copies`), so an app reads it here.

creation.description: The creation starts: every pack's `creation` list in load order, a later start replacing an earlier one with the same `id` in its place. `action` is qualified; `pack` is the pack that declared the start, whose text names it (`creation.<id>.name`).

conflicts.description: Overrides of the same property by two packs; the later pack won.
